title: VinFast to enter India's electric two-wheeler market in first half of 2027
description:
VinFast is eyeing entry into the Indian e-two-wheeler space in 2027, as the Vietnam-based auto giant looks to increase its presence in the fast-growing electric vehicle market.
The company will also manufacture two-wheelers at its facility at Thoothukudi in Tamil Nadu.
Besides, the company also looks to introduce two battery-based four-wheelers in India to capture the increasing demand for compact SUVs (sport utility vehicle) especially from first-time buyers.
VinFast sells four electric car models in India -- the VF 6, VF 7, VF MPV 7, and Limo Green.
The demand for electric two-wheeler and four-wheeler vehicles is growing in India, and the company looks to have a sizeable share in the segment by 2030, VinFast officials told PTI during interactions.
